tools.path_desc: Follow these steps to boost reading retention.
tools.step_1: Read the opening paragraph first to capture the main cultural theme.
tools.step_2: Listen to each sentence carefully, then repeat and shadow it aloud.
tools.step_3: Bookmark important phrases and review them after reading.
tools.word_desc: Look up any vocabulary word from your reading.
tools.word_label: Which word would you like to explore?
